technical:
Hi Ravi,

Sorry you're having trouble signing in. This usually happens when several OTPs are requested in a row - only the newest code works.

Please update the app, wait for the account lock to clear, and request a single fresh OTP. If it still fails, reply here and we will unlock it for you manually.

Warm regards,
QuickCart Customer Support
